Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for reasonable attorneys' fees for dishonored checks.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reasonable attorneys' fees for dishonoredchecks; and amending RCW 62A.3515.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 62A.3515 and 2000 c 215 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (a) If a check as defined in RCW 62A.3104 is dishonored bynonacceptance or nonpayment, the payee or person entitled to enforcethe check under RCW 62A.3301 may collect a reasonable handling fee foreach instrument. If the check is not paid within fifteen days andafter the person entitled to enforce the check or the person's agentsends a notice of dishonor as provided by RCW 62A.3520 to the drawerat the drawer's last known address, and if the instrument does notprovide for the payment of interest or collection costs and attorneys'fees, the drawer of the instrument is liable for payment of interest atthe rate of twelve percent per annum from the date of dishonor, andcost of collection not to exceed forty dollars or the face amount ofthe check, whichever is less, payable to the person entitled to enforcethe check. In addition, in the event of court action on the check, thecourt, after notice and the expiration of the fifteen days, shall award p. 1 SB 5482reasonable attorneys' fees, and three times the face amount of thecheck or three hundred dollars, whichever is less, as part of thedamages payable to the person enforcing the check. This section doesnot apply to an instrument that is dishonored by reason of ajustifiable stop payment order. (b)(1) Subsequent to the commencement of an action on the check(subsection (a)) but prior to the hearing, the defendant may tender tothe plaintiff as satisfaction of the claim, an amount of money equal tothe face amount of the check, a reasonable handling fee, accruedinterest, collection costs equal to the face amount of the check not toexceed forty dollars, and the incurred court costs, service costs, andstatutory or reasonable attorneys' fees, whichever is less. (2) Nothing in this section precludes the right to commence actionin a court under chapter 12.40 RCW for small claims.
